text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While strolling through the academy on a day off,
Matikanefukukitaru came sprinting toward me at breakneck speed.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I finally found you, Trainer-san!
Uuu, thank goodness you're safe...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ah, this is no time to dally!
I must escort Trainer to safety at once!
Right this way, this way!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "And so, without having any idea what was going on, I ran to the station, transferred trains, and was brought to..."

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Here it comes, here it comes, here it comes!
Just a little more effort!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Huh? ...Ah! I'm sorry!
I forgot to explain~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Please stay calm and listen to me, okay?
According to today's fortune, Trainer-san is..."

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Mega mega mega bad luck!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
And so! To save you from a terriii-ble disaster,
I have rushed over, fully equipped with the ultimate lucky charms!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-san, while you're suffering through terrible luck,
I'll be sure to protect you with my good fortune power!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"So please, stay by my side!
If you leave me... lightning might strike, spears might rain down,
and the earth might swallow you whole~!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Matikanefukukitaru spoke with a serious look on her face.
Sure enough, she had been sticking right by me like a bodyguard the entire time we were walking.
choice_data_list: ...So, what brings you all the way out here?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu. Believe it or not, this town is home to
a shrine famous throughout the entire country!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
It is, in a manner of speaking, one of Japan's leading power spots!
I am certain it will exorcise your terrible misfortune, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
First, let's pray... Ah, buying some good luck charms
to gear up is a great option too!
choice_data_list: Maybe going to a shrine would be good.
Maybe a good-luck charm would be good.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: You're right! Praying to the gods is the best way!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
All right, mission start!
Phew... Luomian, limian, mentanpin...
Please let me arrive safely...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, today is a holiday. The foot traffic was far heavier than expected...
and before I knew it, I had gotten separated from Matikane Fukukitaru.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Phew, that was quite a crowd.
We're almost there, though!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
...H-Huh? T-Traaaaiiiineeeer~!
Where are you~?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thinking that moving around aimlessly might cause us to miss each other, I stayed put,
and then received a call from Matikane Fukukitaru.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer, are you all right!?
I'm so sorry, even though I promised I would protect you...!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"...Still, I have no intention of breaking my promise!
I will definitely find it...
So please wait for me!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her voice is filled with resolve and determination.
It is almost as if she isn't the usual Matikanefukukitaru...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: I'll never forgive any terrible bad luck that tries to hurt you, Trainer~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Setting aside the fact that I can see her
shouting into her smartphone about 30 meters ahead.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Hello! Hello!? Are you okay?!
Say something, Traineeeer!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
...Y-Yes!
I'll go pick them up right away!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so... after waiting for 15 minutes
just hoping to be found.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-san~!
Thank goodness... I'm so, so relieved~...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We safely shared an emotional...?
reunion with Matikanefukukitaru.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Phew... For a moment I wasn't sure what would happen,
but we managed to finish our shrine visit, didn't we!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Now you're completely safe and sound!
I made sure to pray that it protects you and your descendants for generations to come, Trainer-san!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: ...Gasp?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Come to think of it, wasn't that wish a bit too grand for just a single shrine visit...!?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
...I really need to make more of an offering!
I'm gonna go buy some good luck charms at the stall!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...In the end, the two of them headed home
with both hands full of bags
packed with good luck charms.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Let's get our gear properly sorted!
All right, let's head out right away!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, if it isn't Fukukitaru!
What a coincidence!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Gyaaaah!?
Taiki-san, Suzuka-san!? Why are you here!?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Why? I just came for some sightseeing, but...
I was thinking of looking for some souvenirs now.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer-san is with you too!
Hellooo to you too!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
W-Wait, you can't!
Don't go near Trainer right now!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Why~? Why is that, desu ka?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I-It's just out of the question!
Right now, I need to stay right by your side, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
No problem sticking together!
Since we ran into each other, let's all four of us walk around together~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Y-You can't come with us! Today is
just me and Trainer, me and Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: It absolutely HAS to be just the two of us~!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant*...!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"...Um, Taiki. I'm not really sure, but
wouldn't it be better not to disturb them?"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, it looks like they want to be alone together right now.
...I'm sure this is an important moment for the two of them.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Mmm~, you want it to be just the two of us...?
Precious time together...?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: ...Oh! Understand!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"Sowwy! Just a little pest dropping by~♪
Please, both of you, enjoy your time together!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I felt like they had gotten the wrong idea about something, but...
the two walked away, leaving Matikane Fukukitaru
letting out a sigh of relief.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Trainer, your sheer bad luck
almost rubbed off on those two as well...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: If rumors of that spread, you might have been banished from the official racing world as the 'Grim Reaper Trainer, Garmin,' Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Now, before any more mishaps occur,
let's hurry and go buy some lucky charms!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: "Anyway, I'll pick out the absolute best product! Just leave it all to me—you're in safe hands, or rather, on a treasure ship!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Matikanefukukitaru made a confident declaration.
However, once they arrived at the shop...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Wahhh?! Amazing!
It's packed full of super-rare good-luck charms~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...In the end, I ended up buying up
every single one I could find.
